<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אדר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917334_theRebbe_880" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_93_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917334_theRebbe_880__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through this, we merit the true and complete redemption, when there will be a revelation of G‑dliness from below, and the bringing of oil and lighting of the menorah will be physical in the Third Beis HaMikdash.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through this we merit, in the very near future, the true and complete redemption,</t>
    <t s="1">when there will be a revelation of G‑dliness also from the aspect of below.</t>
    <t s="2">And then there will be the bringing of the oil and the lighting of the lamps</t>
    <t s="3">(“And you shall take for yourself pure olive oil, to cause the lamp to ascend continually”)</t>
    <t s="4">also in a physical sense,</t>
    <t s="5">in the Third Beis HaMikdash,</t>
    <t s="6">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="7">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
